description: List the US equity market holidays and early-close (1:00 p.m. ET) half days for a calendar year (NYSE/Nasdaq). Defaults to the current year. The calendar is curated for 2025 through 2027; a year outside that range reports so rather than guessing.

year.description: Calendar year, e.g. 2026. Defaults to the current year.
